about_short_description.short_description: Mayhem is a security testing software for developers that identifies defects in apps and APIs.

product.name: Mayhem for Code Security
product.description: Automated testing tool that identifies vulnerabilities in application code and provides proof of exploitability to confirm defects.

product.name: Mayhem for API Security
product.description: Continuous automated testing and validation of APIs to identify and verify security vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10 API risks.

product.name: Mayhem Dynamic SBOM
product.description: Runtime-based Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis that filters out unused components to reduce false security alerts by up to 90%.

product.name: Mayhem Automated Fuzz Testing
product.description: AI-powered fuzz testing combined with symbolic execution to systematically explore code paths and identify complex vulnerabilities in applications.

product.name: Mayhem API Penetration Testing Automation
product.description: Automated API penetration testing tool that performs positive and negative testing to identify OWASP Top 10 API vulnerabilities without requiring agents.
